edited_fraction: 13.4% of stored values for the full low-rank edit; 0.16%-of-parameters variant still changes 7.4%
cost_reported: Claude Opus editor API spend about $799 for the blind cohort ($632/$94/$73), same-protocol run about $20; where-to-edit study 5.9 GPU-hours; operator sessions and GPU time not metered
evidence_notes: WSP is the main subject: Claude Opus editors (and GPT-6 Astra in a companion study) choose where to edit pi0.5 (about 3.35B params, p.4), and the values come from a closed-form ridge solve (p.2, p.21), so solver_delegated. Preregistration covers only the where-to-edit sub-study (p.22), so partial. The explicit rewording at inference matches the edit (57/64 vs 50/64, p.5), unchanged-weight reruns flip about a third of outcomes (p.8), and four of seven blind editors stopped after one candidate (p.20). Code at github.com/adeeb10abbas/weightsmith (p.22). Seven blind editors plus 16-128 paired seeds count as multiple runs.
